Evelyn K: Morning — first day! Monitor arrived but it's a 27\" instead of the 32\" I selected on the onboarding form. Docking station arrived and seems fine. Also I can't see the RedwoodCorp Wi‑Fi from my home office (only seeing RedwoodGuest). Opening ticket INC-2345. @Josh (IT) can you advise? Thanks!

Josh (IT): Welcome aboard, Evelyn — congrats! Can you snap a quick photo of the monitor label (serial/manuf) and paste it here? If the vendor shipped the wrong size we'll set up a pickup + replacement. For Wi‑Fi: RedwoodCorp SSID is office-only; remote staff use the VPN. Do you already have the VPN client installed?

Evelyn K: Photo here: https://imgur.com/abcd123 — monitor label shows SN123456 and model "ViewMax27". My laptop is the M2 Macbook from the onboarding box. I haven't installed any VPN client yet.

Josh (IT): Got the pic, thanks. Looks like we can swap that out. I'll create a return pickup with the vendor and send a prepaid label.

Josh (IT): Quick VPN install steps (mac):
```bash
1) Download SecureConnect from https://internal.redwood/downloads/secureconnect.dmg
2) Install and sign in with your company SSO (okta)
3) Connect to "Redwood-VPN" profile
```
If you hit issues paste any error text here and I'll jump on a call.

it-bot: Ticket INC-2345 state updated to "in_progress" by Josh (IT)

Laura - People Ops: Welcome @Evelyn K :tada: If pickup requires we can ship replacement to your home address — happy to coordinate shipping preferences.

Evelyn K: VPN installed and connected, I can reach the console now. Thanks! For the monitor swap I'd prefer USPS pickup at my home — address is the one I used on the form. Will you need anything else from me?

Josh (IT): Perfect. I'll log the pickup for tomorrow AM and email the return label to your personal inbox on file. Marking INC-2345 for follow-up until device swapped. :thumbsup:

Evelyn K: Amazing, thank you everyone — off to my team intro now!
